## Script Summary 
- Removes lowly expressed genes from the raw miRNA data using `edgeR`

- Applies filtering to all TCGA projects

- Saves processed SummarizedExperiments

## Data Loading
Load in SummarizedExperiment RDS objects and define output directory
```{r data loading}
#Path where the summarized experiment objects you are updating are located
se_directory <- file.path(TCGA, "miR/raw_data/SummarizedExperiments/")
#Path to directory you want to output to
output_directory <- file.path(PATH, "data/mirna/processed_SummarizedExperiments")
```


Here we load in a single TCGA project (BRCA) to show the workflow
```{r Load in BRCA object}
BRCA_raw <- readRDS(file.path(TCGA,"miR/raw_data/SummarizedExperiments/TCGA-BRCA_miRNA.rds"))
```

## Quality Control

### Filtering Lowly Expressed Genes

First, lets remove features that have zero expression
```{r}
BRCA_filtered <- BRCA_raw[rowSums(assay(BRCA_raw,"reads_per_million")) > 0,]
cat("Number of removed miRNAs with zero expression", dim(BRCA_raw)[1] - dim(BRCA)[1] , "\n")
```

Visualizes the distribution of gene counts before and after filtering to see the impact of removing lowly expressed genes.
```{r}
# Distribution of counts before filtering
counts_before <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(BRCA_raw)
row_sums_before <- rowSums(counts_before)

p_before <- ggplot2::ggplot(data.frame(counts = row_sums_before + 1), aes(x = counts)) +
            ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "blue", alpha = 0.7) +
            ggplot2::scale_x_log10() +
            ggplot2::ggtitle("miRNA Counts Distribution Before Filtering")

# Distribution of counts after filtering
counts_after <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(BRCA_filtered)
row_sums_after <- rowSums(counts_after)

p_after <- ggplot2::ggplot(data.frame(counts = row_sums_after + 1), aes(x = counts)) +
           ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "green", alpha = 0.7) +
           ggplot2::scale_x_log10() +
           ggplot2::ggtitle("miRNA Counts Distribution After Filtering")

gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_before, p_after, ncol = 2)
```


```{r}
# Assuming 'counts' is your raw counts matrix and 'BRCA_filtered' is your filtered SummarizedExperiment object
counts <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(BRCA_raw, "raw_counts")
filtered_counts <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(BRCA_filtered, "raw_counts")

# Create DGEList objects for raw and filtered data
dge_raw <- DGEList(counts)
dge_filtered <- DGEList(filtered_counts)

# Calculate log-CPM for raw and filtered data
lcpm_raw <- cpm(dge_raw, log=TRUE)
lcpm_filtered <- cpm(dge_filtered, log=TRUE)

# Determine cutoff for log-CPM with min.count = 5
M <- median(dge_raw$samples$lib.size)
L <- nrow(dge_raw)  # number of genes or miRNAs
lcpm_cutoff <- log2(5/M + 2/L)

# Convert to long format for ggplot2
lcpm_raw_long <- melt(lcpm_raw)
lcpm_filtered_long <- melt(lcpm_filtered)

# Add a status column to distinguish between raw and filtered data
lcpm_raw_long$status <- "Raw"
lcpm_filtered_long$status <- "Filtered"

# Combine both data frames
lcpm_combined <- rbind(lcpm_raw_long, lcpm_filtered_long)

# Create the density plot using ggplot2
ggplot(lcpm_combined, aes(x = value, fill = status)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ status, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Density Plot of Log-CPM Values", x = "Log-CPM", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```



### Normalization
As mentioned in the script summary, normalization is not performed here. But here is the code to perform the TMM normalizaiton method with `edgeR` 
(code is not evaluated)
```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Create DGEList object from filtered data
dge <- DGEList(counts = assay(BRCA_filtered))

# Normalize using TMM
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")

# perform normalization on counts
normalized_counts <- edgeR::cpm(dge, normalized.lib.sizes = TRUE)

if (identical(rownames(normalized_counts), rownames(BRCA_filtered)) & identical(colnames(normalized_counts), colnames(BRCA_filtered))) {
  cat("Creating new SummarizedExperiment with normalized counts...")
  BRCA_normalized <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = list(counts = normalized_counts),
                                          colData = colData(BRCA_filtered),
                                          rowData = rowData(BRCA_filtered))

  # Visualize counts before and after normalization
  counts_before <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(BRCA_filtered)
  counts_after <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(BRCA_normalized)

  # Sample 5 genes to visualize
  set.seed(123)
  sampled_genes <- sample(rownames(counts_before), 5)

  counts_before_sampled <- counts_before[sampled_genes, ]
  counts_after_sampled <- counts_after[sampled_genes, ]

  # Melt data for ggplot
  counts_before_melt <- reshape2::melt(counts_before_sampled)
  counts_after_melt <- reshape2::melt(counts_after_sampled)

  # Add a column to distinguish between raw and normalized counts
  counts_before_melt$Normalization <- 'Before'
  counts_after_melt$Normalization <- 'After'

  # Combine the data
  combined_melt <- rbind(counts_before_melt, counts_after_melt)
2
  # Create a combined density plot
  p <- ggplot(combined_melt, aes(x = value, fill = Normalization)) +
       geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
       scale_x_log10() +
       ggtitle("Density Plot of Counts Before and After Normalization") +
       labs(x = "Counts (log scale)", y = "Density") +
       theme_minimal()

  print(p)

} else {
  cat("Cannot create new SummarizedExperiment: Samples/Genes are mismatched")
}
```



## Apply Filtering to all TCGA projects
This section applies the filtering and normalization steps to all SummarizedExperiment objects 
```{r filter SEs}
# Create a list of all files ending in .rds in se_directory
file_list <- list.files(path = se_directory, pattern = "*.rds", full.names = TRUE)

# Initialize a data frame to store the summary information
summary_table <- data.frame(Project = character(),
                            RemovedFeatures = numeric(),
                            RemainingFeatures = numeric(),
                            stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Loop through each file
for (file_path in file_list) {
  cat("Filtering and saving ", file_path, "\n")
  
  # Read the SummarizedExperiment object
  se_obj <- readRDS(file_path)
  
  # Filter lowly expressed genes
  keep <- edgeR::filterByExpr(SummarizedExperiment::assay(se_obj), min.count = 5, min.prop = 0.3)
  se_obj_filtered <- se_obj[keep, ]
  
  # Track the number of removed and remaining genes
  removed_genes <- sum(!keep)
  remaining_genes <- sum(keep)
  
  # Append the information to the summary table
  project_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file_path))
  summary_table <- rbind(summary_table, data.frame(Project = project_name,
                                                   Removed_miRNAs = removed_genes,
                                                   Remaining_miRNAs = remaining_genes))
  
  # Ensure sample order still matches
  if (identical(colnames(se_obj), colnames(se_obj_filtered))) {
    
    # Save output
    output_path <- file.path(output_directory, basename(file_path))
    saveRDS(se_obj_filtered, output_path)
    
    cat("Saved normalized SummarizedExperiment to", output_path, "\n\n")
  } else {
    cat("Cannot create new SummarizedExperiment: Samples/Genes are mismatched\n")
  }
}

# Print the summary table
reactable::reactable(summary_table, searchable = TRUE, resizable = TRUE)
```
